title: Your Cousin Is in Trouble
intro: A call comes at dinner. A stranger says your cousin has been in an accident and arrested.
This time you can talk back. Pick your replies and sniff each message as it arrives.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: Your cousin was arrested after an accident

msg: I am a police officer. Your cousin Dev has been

msg.text: The other person is badly hurt.
We need $1,000 now to settle it and avoid a case.

replies.text: I will hang up and call Dev myself

msg: . Then we will take him to the station.

msg.text: And do not tell his parents.

replies.text: I will call Dev and his parents myself first

num.label: An unknown number
num.lens: A stranger, not a number you know.
num.why: Check with your family on numbers you already know.

arrested.label: "Arrested after an accident"
arrested.lens: A shocking story with no proof.
arrested.why: Shock is the weapon. Stop and check.

money.label: "Pay now to avoid a case"
money.lens: Real arrests are not settled by cash in minutes.
money.why: No honest officer takes cash by phone.

crying.label: He "cannot talk"
crying.lens: They stop you hearing him, so you cannot check.
crying.why: A real relative can come to the phone.

secret.label: "Do not tell his parents"
secret.why: Always tell the family. It breaks the scam.

actions.label: Call Dev and his parents myself, on numbers I know
Hang up and report the call

block_report.line: You hung up and reported the call. The number was blocked.

verify.line: Dev picked up at once. He was at home, safe and confused. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The money went to a stranger. Dev was at home all evening, perfectly fine.

what_if.go_ahead: One call to Dev on a number you know would have ended it in 20 seconds.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the number as well protects other families.

golden_rule: If a stranger says a relative is in trouble and wants money, hang up and call the relative on a number you know. It takes a minute.

quick_check.q: A stranger calls to say your cousin was arrested and you must send money in 10 minutes. What do you do?

options.text: Send half and ask for details
Hang up and call your cousin and his family on numbers you know
Ask the caller for his badge number

quick_check.explain: Check on a number you know. A real relative answers.

hints.nudge: How can you check without trusting the caller?

rows.k: Could Dev come to the phone?

rows.v: Check on a number you already know
